api:
<Funnel data={stages} name={|s: &Stage| s.name} value={|s: &Stage| s.count} />
PropTypeDefault
valueFn(&T) -> f64required
colorone colour for every stagea series colour per stage
show_valuesbooltrue
horizontaltrue

Bars centred on one line, in your order, so each stage's drop-off is visible.

examples.title: Sign-up funnel
examples.description: Each stage centred, as wide as its count.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn signup() {
    let data = use_signal(steps(&[
        ("Visited", 12_400.),
        ("Signed up", 4_100.),
        ("Activated", 2_300.),
        ("Subscribed", 640.),
        ("Renewed", 410.),
    ]));
    rsx! { <Funnel data={data} name={|s: &Step| s.name} value={|s: &Step| s.value} class="h-72" /> }
}
